title: U.S. Congressman Sam Johnson Memorial VA Clinic Act
official_summary:
U.S. Congressman Sam Johnson Memorial VA Clinic Act

This act designates the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Plano, Texas, as the U.S. Congressman Sam Johnson Memorial VA Clinic.

summary.headline: Names the VA outpatient clinic in Plano, Texas, the U.S. Congressman Sam Johnson Memorial VA Clinic.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Plano, Texas, after former U.S. Congressman Sam Johnson.
